voice.summary: Slowtick sounds like a patient study partner who watches the clock so you don't have to. It is encouraging without pushing, and treats breaks as seriously as work.
dos: Use the session count and the mode in each message
Treat breaks as part of the work
Keep timer words short: start, skip, reset
donts: Do not use guilt when a session is skipped

taglines: Focus a little, rest a little
A gentle clock for good days
One session, then a proper break
boilerplate: Slowtick is a focus timer with focus, short break and long break modes, session dots and a simple log of the day's completed work.

microcopy.success: Session 1 done. Take a short break.
microcopy.error: The chime could not play. The timer is still running.
microcopy.empty: No sessions yet today. Press Start.

logo.note: A dial is the clock face at the heart of the timer.
